notes.title: Update 1.8 - Online Co-Op Beta: Phase Two
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25309398/e016c0b008a3e4cab7c59037246dc0b3720fad83.png

Welcome all!

Oh, how the time flies! It was like yesterday that we've announced the beta phase of the online co-op game mode in Fury Unleashed, and now we're getting ready for the next step - more on it below. We're also happy to release another set of improvements from the beta build into the stable release for all of you to enjoy!

On a side note, we've been experimenting with different storefront artwork, and our artist drew a new piece to freshen things up a bit. You can get a full-resolution version by clicking the image below:

           {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25309398/ef2948657dfef9e5ac2c16ce1517a3992c1de0d4.png


Online Co-Op Beta - Second Phase

The Online Co-Op mode is now available for everyone in the PC version of the game - that means Linux and macOS also. You can play it on the main build version, by selecting it from the main menu.

We might not be ready to release Online Co-Op as a finished product just yet, but we can't wait anymore to share the fruit of our combined effort with you, our players!

The beta branch proved to be very helpful to find all the new ways to break the game and make it cry in the corner. We've since bought so many sweet and comfort things to ease out its pain, that we believe the core problems to be fixed already.

But, non-core problems are problems still, so we can't say our work on the online mode is done. That's why it is still labelled as a "BETA", but now, it's even more accessible and easier to just jump in and have fun with friends old and new.



Fixes & Quality of Life

 While we worked on the online mode, we've also implemented lots of improvements to the overall experience, which will also changes few things in both single player & local co-op modes.

 Some of those changes consist of things we've been asked about, but for different reasons were on the back burner of the to-do list. It's always important for us to receive feedback from you - the players - on what would you like to see improved/changed, as it's entirely possible, that we'll implement these things in the future. Don't be afraid to share your thoughts with us!

Here's a very brief list of changes. Take note, that it consists of few spoilers!
Enemies in the Epilogue chapter now [spoiler]drop black ink, to ease out the leveling experience[/spoiler].
"SUPERHOT" & "Crypt of the NecroDancer" game modes can now be played with "Full" controller aim-assist (previously "High" was the maximum), making them more accessible for all players.
Some bosses had their amount of HP adjusted, not to feel so "spongy" and improve the flow.
Crash fixes for the Steam Workshop interface and other rare circumstances & cases.
Some UI elements are now properly selectable and/or clickable with every controller option.
Improved translations for every language, with support for the new online-related lines.
Dozens of improvements to both co-op modes. E.g. [spoiler]player resurrection[/spoiler] inside the Epilogue chapter.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25309398/fade493e3df16e29f780f7c9487e4fe8716cba1e.png

Thankfully, most of these are now marked as "DONE" 😜


What's next?

As always, we try to be as transparent, as we can. Online co-op took way more time to implement than we originally anticipated, and the global pandemic certainly didn't help with the schedules. While not being flawless with the dates, we strive to improve!

We're still working hard on polishing the player experience and won't stop until online mode is ready to be fully release on both the PC and consoles. What comes after wholly depends on the game's popularity and demand.

We've got heads full of ideas and passion, so we hope for all of you to stay with us and support us going further into the great unknown - our fun might just begin!

notes.title: Update 1.7 - Crypt of the NecroDancer & SUPERHOT 💥 New game modes!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25309398/61d9bc29f9a1793078b71fcf449c58d455b86429.png

Hi everyone!

Let's make this winter super hot with some dance rhythms - Two additional guest appearance modes are now available in Fury Unleashed for everyone to play, on every platform!

We've also made a very short trailer for this update. Check it out:
[previewyoutube=idltJij5ZZs;full][/previewyoutube]

Crypt of the NecroDancer

What is it about? This mode lets you play the role of Cadence, the hero of the original game (of the same title). Armed with a trusted shovel and a deadly crossbow, she waltzes through the game's diverse environments, shooting bad guys to the rhythm of the music. The tempo of the music tracks varies level to level, culminating within main boss arenas in which players have to stay true to the rhythm to survive.

How to unlock it? Each comic-book is a level of its own, so you'll need to defeat one of the main bosses in a set comic at least once, to access its content in "Crypt of the NecroDancer - Fury Unleashed" mode. There are 3 levels overall, each for every comic-book.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25309398/f45656f7b7c533f32fa547fbdb58b177c9d1daca.gif

SUPERHOT

What is it about? "SUPERHOT" turns around the ingame rules, making time stop when the hero doesn't move and flow when they do. That doesn't mean the game's easy though, as you now can survive just one hit before starting over. Still, you can use the Fury Unleashed's combo system to get additional damage shields based on how well you dispose of the enemies standing before you.

How to unlock it? Each comic-book is a level of its own, so you'll need to defeat one of the main bosses in a set comic at least once, to access its content in "SUPERHOT - Fury Unleashed" mode. There are 3 levels overall, each for every comic-book.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25309398/45abaf37d363978140dc0f7fc3623604c558e85d.gif

Hi everyone!

Save & Quit!

We're finally able to bring you the new feature, which lets you close the game and come back later to continue playing the same run. We're sorry it took so long, but it required a lot more work than we thought. Still, we strive for the best and hope this new feature will be a help to all of you, as well as a great foundation for the online session loading system, that's needed for the upcoming online co-op mode.

Currently, both single-player and local co-op games can be saved but keep in mind that you can only store a single save-state at a time. The system allows you to exit the current run and reload it later at any time, except for these cases: While fighting any of the mini & main bosses,
 In the tutorial level, as well as some other plot points of the game,
 Inside secret & sketch trap levels/events,
 If the application is force-quitted (e.g. ALT+F4).
These restrictions were added mostly to decrease the possibility of something going wrong with the save file, as well as to limit the abuse potential.

notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25309398/9240f657341e295bb3dd5bc7ec4f2e64887f13f3.png

Hello everyone!

It has been some time since the last update; we understand that for some of our fans, it might felt like an eternity. Some of us had a short break to catch a breath after years of development of Fury Unleashed and return to you with new ideas and energy to implement them.

We've also been steadily working on adding the foundations for Online Co-op mode, and it will come in a later update. For that reason, we've been implementing a Save & Quit feature, which is now almost complete, but we've wanted to test and polish it a bit more before the public release. We're also changing the version naming (1.0.4 > 1.5) with the aim of unifying the numbering with the other (console) versions of the game. Sorry for the potential confusion!

Still, we didn't want you to wait any longer, so here's a slew of fixes, upgrades, and additions to the game - enjoy!

Interface scaling!
Some of you were asking us for a way to increase the readability of the game, especially on smaller screens or being far from the TV. Thanks to your feedback, there's now a new slider in the options menu. It lets you decide on the size of the in-game font as well as of selected interface elements. Grab your favorite brand of tea, cover yourself with a blanket, and unleash your fury from the comfort of your sofa, without the added strain on your eyes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25309398/9657dfe784de1d10544d844d8d05bde10dbf3f28.gif

Steam Rich Presence!
That might not blow your mind but will blow those of your buddies on the Steam Friends List. Now, everyone can see which part of the comic-book universe are you in at a current moment, and why are you fighting those aliens without them. Tell them not to worry, as Steam Remote Play works as intended, and online co-op will come when ready!

Balance changes!
We want the game to be fun for everyone, and not feel too long or too short for anyone, so we keep our fingers on the pulse. Some tactics like stacking lots of armors were a bit overpowered, so we're tweaking them, as well as making adjustments to the leveling curve, for the game to feel more rewarding and less grindy.
Starting weapons are now better, faster, stronger.
Environmental traps are slower on the first comic-book page.
Armors are weakened by having fewer defense points. Toss a coin to your armorer~
Bosses now have less HP across the board. Less bullet-spongy, same unhealthy-deadly.
More black ink drops from basic enemies, but less for elite, bosses, and from item trades.
Less ink from the combo multiplier. You're still awarded more of it, but not in an unhealthy way.
And more!
New skin colors to choose from for both of the default Fury models.
SteelSeries GameSense support added to make your life more colorful.
Improvements and corrections to some of the game's language versions.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25309398/9adb438291c557bd306aba1183272d4ce9717228.gif
Also, bugfixes:
One of the challenges from the Death NPC will no longer occasionally crash the game.
Descriptions of enchants on weapons should now properly fit the text panel in every language.
Additional preventions against being locked outside rooms hosting a Sketch Chaos Invasion event.
The Bat enemy no longer makes ears bleed with how loud it screeches. It screams in pain quietly.
Other, minor stuff, we've fixed along the way.
PAX x EGX 2020 & Demo version!
As a bonus, we'd like to let you know that we're taking part in this year's PAX Online x EGX event! Our participation consists of not only having a [virtual booth] but also providing everyone with a demo version on Steam. You are welcomed to [try the game for free] if you like - Steam's demo will be available until September 20.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25309398/06bc791469b773fcb5a83065b2ffa190a7b89450.gif


As usual, we wouldn't be here if not for our awesome community and its feedback. Thank you, everyone, for all the bugs you've reported, and the woes you've shared, and that cake you sent us some time ago. Unfortunately, we have yet to receive it, but we truly believe it wasn't a lie.

Stay unleashed!

notes.title: Update 1.0 - Fury Unleashed Full Release!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25309398/a6e6e39a43253a522c728ae5677d9566ab5a3754.png

Welcome, everyone!

The time has finally come, and after 5 years of work, we're finally releasing the full version of our labor of love, which is Fury Unleashed. Thank you all for your support over the span of the 3 years-long Early Access period! Both the positive comments and constructive feedback were of irreplaceable help.

But that's it; we're finally here! So, let's jump straight into the good stuff:

 Epilogue chapter now available!
The surprise final chapter, we've been working on for around a year now, is finally ready to be played! Explore the mysterious world contained inside the series author's sketchbook. Enjoy the different gameplay than before, with a new way of traversing the level. Many additional difficulties are awaiting those brave enough to face the most unfriendly environment yet. In fact, it's so unfriendly, that at times, you might happen to get stuck in it for a little while (wink, wink). Don't give up your hope, though, as you are very close to becoming THE hero of this hand-drawn universe.

 Twitch and Mixer integration!
As a streamer, you are now able to link the game with your favorite service and allow players to vote for what rewards are you getting from in-game portals. There are also additional challenges waiting for those brave enough to put their comic-book life at the stake of violence-hungry viewers! There are also some streaming parameters to be adjusted in the configuration menu, in the game's options.

There is also a new option, that we found could prove helpful to streamers; music can be toggled to stay on while the focus is no longer on the game's window. This option is toggled off by default, but when enabled, our OST can now be used as background music on streams... or while cleaning your room?

 Three new skins
There are three new skins available. Each of them is unlocked by finishing the game on appropriate difficulty mode. I wonder, how many of you will smile upon seeing the reward for the successful Legendary run :)

 New achievements
Speaking of Legendary; there are new achievements available, related both to the new content, as well as additional skill-based ones, for all of the hardcore players to prove they ain't softcore! So, what will you do this fine evening - get a combo of 500, or finish the game on a single combo streak? Decisions, decisions.

 Steam Trading Cards
Collectors, rejoice! There are now trading cards, waiting to be dropped by spending some quality time with Fury Unleashed. There is a total of 9 cards, the same number of backgrounds, 5 emoticons, and all those sweet levels of profile badge to get! Don't forget to tell us which one's your favorite!

 Lots of smaller changes
 We are constantly busy with fixing potential problems, enhancing the experience, and adding balance and QoL changes. Here's today's batch of those:
We've found full auto-aim option on gamepads to be a little too powerful at times, so we've limited it to Easy mode. Three other versions of aim-assist are still available on every mode.
New sounds and fixes to mastering issues. Lots of them in fact, both for enemies and male/female versions of Fury. Some screams are simply to die for!
Exploding barrels and "friendly" grenade boxes now have a new prompt, informing players of additional ways of interaction; barrels can be thrown at enemies, grenade boxes can be broken for bonus ink.
Small improvements to the tutorial level, both graphically, and in level structure. Feel free to once again learn the ropes of obliterating your foes, if you want to!
Other minor bug fixes and QoL changes. Don't worry, we've made the game better for you to play, so simply jump right into it and have fun! :)

Remember, that we are always happy to receive new feedback from our players, and in case of any technical issues, we'll do our best to help you in fixing them. Join us on [Steam Forums] or our [Discord server] to chat about the game and tell us how awesome it is to cut a skeleton in half... vertically.

Stay awesome!
Awesome Games Studio Team

Hello again!

Lately, we used the first paragraph to convey the "coming soon" news, without pointing at specific dates. This time, we are ready to announce some concrete things. Let's get ready to... update!

 Demo version & full release
This might not be the main point of the patch, but we think it is important enough to post it first. We would like to announce that the demo version of the game named "Fury Unleashed: Prologue" will be available on March 30.

If you are interested, you can wishlist the Prologue now, to receive a notification on its release:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1262960
The same day, we will announce the release date, so stay tuned! The prologue will be available on to everyone, who wants to try out the game for free, and it will consist of the first comic, although having some content from the full version cut out. Best thing is that any progress made will automatically transfer to the full version, so there is no reason not to tell your friends to have a try when it becomes available.

Don't let your Fury's weapons cool down through, as it's not a bad idea to practice before new content arrives with the full release version.

 Equipment rarity & enchantments
Following our players' feedback, we are once again making tweaks in the equipment department. This time, we are introducing a notable difference in item tiers, as well as improving some things.

From now on, items you gain are tiered as common, rare, and legen... wait for it... dary! This doesn't always mean that a legendary item will be better than common one in every situation, but it adds a new layer of depth into any playthrough and will help some players decide on which item to choose.

Another thing added with this update is weapon enchantments, which are random now, and usually not locked in place with certain tools of destruction. Even though your flamethrower would make the enemies blow up on death and cause collateral damage to their surroundings? Or maybe you thought, that that one railgun didn't have enough "freeze anything its beam touches"? Well, times have changed, and now are the times of acid imbued heavy machine guns.

As the items are tiered now, we can further improve upon the rewards system. Normal "blue" item chests will now usually grant players mostly common items, with a chance for a rare one. But the rewards for secret challenges, defeating bosses, and other great feats of strengths, will now be guaranteed to grant players at least a rare, if not legendary item!

 Two new skins & more customization
This time, we'll be adding not one, but two new skins! What are their name and background is for you to decide, as you are free to roleplay them in any way. Was the Fury warped into a skeletal cultist, that fights against his new lord's will? Or did our hero just return from a cold-war space exploration mission as a now-immortal astronaut? Our guesses are as good as yours :) You can unlock new skins as a reward for [spoiler]achieving the combos of 100 and 150[/spoiler].

With this update, we are also enabling the custom heads from Steam Workshop to be used with any of the unlocked skins! No longer will you be forced to use your custom-made OC cybernetic ancient demon's head with a body of a mere mortal. Cyber-Ancient-Demon-Furry it is!

 New aiming system and animations
For a long time, we were thinking about polishing the visual side of how the character animations on weapon aiming looks and functions. We've decided to change some things, and as of now, if Fury isn't actively shooting at anything, his/hers/its hand will fall into a neutral, resting position. This also makes the weapon's default red laser pointer disappear, until it is needed again to point out doom for the enemies.

This one, we'd especially love to hear what are your thoughts about. Those changes may (or may not) affect the way you play on both the keyboard+mouse and on the gamepads. We believe that it makes Fury's movement look more natural and "clean", as the hero isn't constantly targeting everything with murderous intent. Everyone deserves a moment to contemplate from time to time on how nothing in the universe can stop you.

Optimization - of course, it has further improved, as we strive for more with almost every consecutive update :)

notes.title: Update #62 - Furry Unleashed, boss reworks, soundtrack now available!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25309398/364d6487cd257be0add95f1eba2b64cc90090143.png

Hi everyone!

Here we are, at the final lap, so without further ado, let's jump into things coming in this patch.

 New boss and a facelift of the old ones
A new boss has been added for the first comic: Corrupted Hive. Its power is reliant on insects that reside inside, but it can also "pack a punch" by itself, or so they say. Some of the other bosses had visual tweaks both to their attacks and their looks. Most importantly, Master of Souls and Priest of Souls both had reworks, so now, their respective fights with Fury look and proceed differently than before. Prepare to be challenged anew! There are more bosses and enemies on the way, but you'll have to fight them on the game's full launch!

 Soundtrack released
Our jamming tunes, composed by The Witcher's composers Adam 'Scorpik' Skorupa and Krzysztof Wierzynkiewicz, are finally available in their full glory! Following the recent changes to how OST sales can work on Steam, it's not a DLC, so even people who don't own the game can buy it. Our soundtrack consists of 24 songs in MP3 and FLAC formats, and you can acquire it here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1232750/Fury_Unleashed_Soundtrack/

 A new skin - Furry
We've heard people misread our game's title as "Furry Unleashed" so many times that it was simply natural for us to embrace the idea. We are open to new ideas, and with that in mind, there was no reason not to include an option tailored for our vulpine friends out there! So, here we are. You've told us that fury isn't the only thing that could be unleashed, and we've listened. Furry skin is unlocked as a reward for [spoiler]achieving a combo of 30[/spoiler]. Just... try not to force us to change the game's title again, please? It would make an awesome April Fool's Day joke, though.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25309398/e9e135b023bba952fa9044389d26d77834c8b4d3.gif

 Bloodless mode
There's also something for people who either dislike seeing blood and dismemberments or are would like to play the game while young children are around. We've added Bloodless mode, where there is no presence of red liquids, and enemies "poof!" out of existence, instead of dying graphically. You can activate it at any time in the game's options menu. Do try it at home!

 Optimization & fixes
We've spent a countless amount of hours since the last patch, streamlining the data, and optimizing the game. We understand that it isn't something that we can display like fireworks accompanied by orchestral fanfares but believe us. We did a lot of things for the game so that it will run better on low-end machines, and also there should be more than enough memory left for those pesky browser tabs ;)

There were also errors waiting to be fixed, so we did just that. Thanks for all the reports! Here's a list of some of the bugfixes:
 Lots of co-op fixes and quality of life (e.g. separate map control), but there's still more to come!
 Weapons no longer tend to stack on each other visually. RIP amalgamations of a rocket launcher and a crossbow.
 Sometimes, sketch event and secret challenge enemies would spawn in different spots than anticipated. Nevermore.
 Ninja quest for melee assassinations now targets enemies that are designed to be cut, sliced, and diced.
 Fast traveling using a mouse click won't accidentally start firing Fury's weapon like it used to.
 Accidental left-stick presses will no longer keep the map open, and also there's a menu option to disable it altogether
 Ultrawide screen resolution are now fully supported

Thanks to everyone in the community, and special thanks to: ChrissyHia, cjrunfiles, gerrard725, HiddenStake, PlaSmiCNoMaD, SexyPanther and Yeldo for the feedback that helped us improve the game.

Finally, we have one important announcement for those who haven't decided to buy the game yet, but are following its development: Fury Unleashed's price will be increased on March 2nd. It'll cost 19.99$/19.99€ or the corresponding price in case of other currencies - so if you want to get it ahead of the upcoming full release, now is the best time.

As usual, join us on our social media (links below) and have a chat with us - as well as the rest of the community - on our [Discord server] or [Steam Forums].

Stay awesome!

Hello everyone!

As we are tirelessly preparing the final chapter of Fury's journey, we've made sure to bring an update for all of our Early Access players. We hope you are excited to dive into the new stuff and improvements we prepared for everyone!

 Weapon unlocks and a new NPC
Enigmatic Mistress of Fate makes her first appearance. Being an entity, that exists between comic and chaos worlds, she can be found in unusual places, communicating with Fury through spirit skulls that surround her. She will provide the hero with sketches, used to unlock new weapons for the player, which can be later found in the world or obtained from other non-playable characters. Completing secret levels will also grant Fury an offer of different rewards to choose from the Mistress herself.

 Gunlord's arsenal overhauled
Fury's old friend is back, and you should see him a lot more often. Now Gunlord does not only help with loadout unlocks but also sports an arsenal of guns to sell, that's worthy of his name. Of course, everyone needs a hero, and it will be your job to provide Gunlord with additional tools of destruction, by completing the beforementioned sketches.

 Updated handbook & workshop support
An in-game item list was added to the handbook to complement the unlock system. You can now check weapons, garments, and other items, both available in your playthroughs, and those of which you need to unlock by a sketch. Additional love was given to the Steam Workshop system, as from now on, it has a better integration in the hero appearance menu. We are excited to see what new characters will the community make and upload to the workshop!

 Optimization, quality of life and eye-candy
As usual, we spent many hours on how the game works, raising the framerate while not decreasing visual or audio quality. In fact, we improved the quality by adding new effects as well as lots of additional detail and eye-candy to the second and third comics. Fast travel system was reworked slightly - you'll spend less time pressing buttons, more time traveling. It needs a second to get used to, but it's worth it! Also, you will always be able to travel to any rooms available while using gamepads, which was previously impossible in certain rare cases.


Naturally, that is not everything included in today's update, but here's another glimpse of "everything":
 First batch of fixes for co-op mode. We know that there is a lot of work still to be done for it to work flawlessly, and we are committed to fixing all of the problems in the end.
 Crosshair style and size changes in options while in-game are simultaneously shown in realtime.
 Bunch of improvements on different translations, and a new Chinese font.
 Addition of new secret levels/rooms (and there is still more to come!).
 There is a new logo of our company, so we'll exhibit it seamlessly while the main menu loads.
 So many fixes, we gained a level by just squashing the bugs.

Special thanks to everyone who helped with their bug reporting and feedback, which includes, but is not limited to: ChrissyHia, Glaidy, johnstein, King MOS, NiteCrawla, Oilyscoob, Saifon, Thomot512, Thultex, Watinga, Weasel, Wn3ku, Yeldo, and Zeforas.

notes.content:

Hi everyone!

New weapons
12 types of tools of destruction are added in today’s update. Now you can inspire fear in evildoers by using new attacks, like energy pulses, proton lasers, sticky grenades, soul skulls, freezing beams or even by sending swarms of stinging insects at their faces or those things that they sometimes have in place of the face.

Chaos Chests
Another powerful creature lured its ugly (but well-drawn!) head from the depths of Chaos. It is capable of controlling surrounding enemies, empowering them and even making them immortal as long as it exists. We’ve done a ton of optimizations to the game, including a change to how levels are loaded. Previously, the levels would load in the background, while you were already playing, which occasionally caused hiccups in performance, especially on slower machines. Now, we’ve added a bit of loading time between the chapters, but when you actually start playing, the game will be as smooth as possible from the very first frame.

But that's not all. List of changes also includes (but is not limited to):

 Lots of eye-candy, such as vegetation and other objects, that reacts to player movement, bullets or explosions. 
 Boss progress reports, showing how many more you have to defeat to permanently unlock starting the game from subsequent episodes

 Visual loading screens for comic pages, frame by frame
 Another batch of freshly picked new levels / rooms
 Usual extermination of found bugs

notes.title: Update #56 - Chaos invasions, weapon sets, new skills, more Fury!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25309398/5a0d831c590584396488e0fb1830a9aeec65d815.png
Hi everyone!

Today’s update brings lots of new things bigger and smaller, as well as many bug fixes and quality of life changes:

 Sketch events
Fury’s world becomes even more unstable. From time to time, as you play, you will encounter strange events, which makes the whole comic frame you are in lose colors. Chaos invades the world, and you are forced to fight against it to return it to how it supposed to be… or is it?

 Weapon switching
Now you can hold two sets of weapons (thanks to cylervan for the suggestion) and switch between them wherever you want by using the corresponding button (by default: C on keyboard, right thumbstick press on gamepad)! No longer will you be forced to use one tool for every situation, as you might want to burn some enemies with a flamethrower and pierce others with laser beams.

 Better movement
Fury’s got new dance moves. Jokes aside, controlling your character feels better than ever with improvements to how he/she snaps to and vault over terrain obstacles. Leave your double jump to when it is needed to crush, kill, and destroy.

 New skill tree
Many improvements come to the way how you customize your character. The whole skill tree is now on a single page, branching into three paths in which you can freely upgrade (and downgrade, restoring spent points) your hero to your liking. There are also new skills available, like Stomp Shockwave, Temporary Invulnerability, and Superpower Shield.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25309398/a3c4715be9e62165b8f571985ef3371449f33706.png

 New levels / room configurations and a new type of secret rooms, where you fight waves of enemies (thanks Nikola for the suggestion)
 Better audio - new effects and ambient sounds
 The map stays open when accessed by quick tapping the corresponding button
 Proper loading screen was added
 Change in the naming of difficulty levels ("Normal" is now "Hard")
 Balance and visual improvements
 Total annihilation of reported bugs


We hope you will have as much fun playing the game as we have to create it for you. There is still more to come, mainly in the inclusion of the fourth world: the sketchbook. We are working hard on making it an awesome experience you are all waiting for, so get ready for it!

notes.title: Update #53 – Tons of guns, Ninja, and The Devil!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25309398/38f42b10672493e2158e0c54d46b35266df30f9e.png

Hello everyone,

For a long time now, you’ve only had a few classic guns at your disposal. With today’s update, we’re tripling the number of firearms you’ll find throughout the comic books! The list includes:

- Flamethrowers
- Lasers
- Grenade Launchers
- Crossbows
- Railguns
- Dark Energy Guns
- Blasters
- Impulse Guns
- Acidthrowers
- Plasma Guns
- Alien Rocket Launchers
- Sawblade Launchers
- Alien Shard Launchers
- Nailguns

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25309398/8bd7367786a3704dfb2e98b4dfce45c3fb83f562.png

They are all available for you to find right now, but in the next update we’ll introduce a system of unlocks, and it’ll require a bit of effort to get them. So this is the best time to lay your hands on those weapons!

We would also like to introduce two new fellas – Ninja and The Devil. They may not sound like they belong in the same universe, but as worthy NPCs, they will surely become a beloved part of Fury Unleashed’s world.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25309398/779dd5830458de65b85a3be60e4ee4df30288ab2.png

The Devil is actually quite a mischievous character – he would never disregard a good, fresh soul. And selling yours to him doesn’t necessarily have to be a bad idea. The transaction will reduce some of your maximum HP, but it will reward you with quite a few neat gameplay bonuses. So if you’ve mastered your dodging skills and don’t need too much HP, you really should consider doing a deal!

Also, if you enjoy an occasional spot of blade-based slaughter, there’s Ninja, who will be happy to send you on several quests and reward you for killing enemies just with your melee weapon. So better start sharpening your stabbing tools!

Okay, so finally the part with major updates is behind us. Time for the minor, yet still interesting ones. Here we go:

- From now on, the Commander X NPC will provide you with more quests, which you will perform on an entire page of the comic book;
- The process of gaining a combo shield by a player now has its own visual effect;
- More visual improvements to the first and second comics;
- Bug fixes and game-balance changes.

Furthermode, we'd like to thank our most active Discord user, 🎃 Sherif 🎃 for loads of bug reports and suggestions! Every bit of feedback is incredibly valuable to us, especially in ths final phase of development. Please keep it coming! (by the way, congrats on beating the Legendary mode!)

That’s it for now; thanks for reading this! Remember to join our social media channels (Discord, Facebook, Twitter) so you’ll never miss anything interesting from the development process. 

See you soon!
Awesome Games Studio Team

notes.title: Update #46 - Fury Unleashed’s storyline unveiled!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25309398/94f404f829150565a43c143cfd8586010b8fe1f4.png
Hello Heroes!

We have quite a piece for you today. But before we begin, please meet your new companion – Mr. Doodle. Starting today, he will assist you as a guide through the world of Fury Unleashed. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25309398/754996c42a225609c4117bb49b2efbb473bc70e9.png

Mr. Doodle will tell you the entire enigmatic story that fills the pages of our comic book. He will be providing narration, leading you through all the blood-curdling battles and struggles. Don’t get us wrong, he won’t help you dispatch any monsters on the way – absolutely not. He just does the talking. 

Our pal will introduce you to the stories in the three available comics, and when it’s time to leave Early Access, each story will come to an end with the addition of Epilogue World, which takes place in the sketchbook. Believe us when we tell you: it’s worth the wait!

As usual, we have even more for you today. We really enjoy treating you to new functionalities and seeing you all having fun learning new possibilities and discovering how to beat completely fresh obstacles and opponents. So how about adding a bunch once again?

Here are the details:

The new NPC – The Order of Eternal Ink, where you can get a blessing for a small fee;
New traps that occur at dark stages;
The possibility to further adjust the Easy difficulty level during the game through an option in the pause menu;
Improved sounds related to your activity in the game (shots, melee attacks, jumps, etc.);
And as usual, bug fixes and performance optimizations.

That’s it for today, Heroes. Thanks for stopping by. If you like what you see, consider following us on our social media (Discord channel, Facebook, and Twitter!) to make sure you’re always up to date with all that we have in store.

Farewell!

notes.title: Update #39 - The female character is here, accompanied by a completely new soundtrack!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25309398/82f7984536bd7727ff1cc4765ccd138ecdee575a.png

You asked for it, we promised to deliver, and here it is! From now on you can play not only as a badass looking male character but also a female one. And trust us when we tell you, the girls in our game are equally as capable of kicking alien butts as the guys. If not more. It took them a while to join the fight, so now they are all pumped, ready, and impatient for some serious action. Don’t take our word for it though, look at the ladies below and you’ll discover that “fight like a girl” just got a whole new meaning.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25309398/434ba76533e25743af09a3ff29f13d2a5a77ba5e.gif

But it’s not the only good news we have for you today! Fighting bad guys is fun but doing so while listening to an awesome music score is a real treat. notes.title: Update #23 – Call to arms! The Last Stand of Earth is upon us!
notes.content:

We know you've been waiting for this moment for quite some time – we’re proud to say the wait is over! The third comic book – The Last Stand of Earth – is shaping up really well and we're ready to share the first part of the story with you. 🙂

Prepare to fight your way through a completely new environment, eliminate hordes of enemies and defend the Earth from aliens! The Last Stand of Earth features:

•	Eleven brand new enemies to eliminate,
•	Three minibosses,
•	One superboss,
•	An intro and outro to the comic book.

The update also introduces five new melee weapons and one small but significant change – from now on, instead of an empty hand, every Badass Hero has hold of a melee weapon. Holding the weapon in your hand let’s you know you can use it at anytime, and – most importantly – it looks badass!

Another small change is the introduction of new control configuration options: gamepad auto-fire, left-stick jump, and auto jump-down. Feel free to adjust it to your preference, and if you have any other suggestions about gamepad controls let us know! 

Adding the third comic book means more gameplay and – we hope – more fun! 🙂 We’ve decided to keep the current price tag until February 7th – but after that the price will increase a little to $11.99/€11.99/£8.49/pуб.299/29.99 PLN

notes.title: Update #15: Melee weapons, custom heads, new soundtrack and more!
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25309398/23829532b04d262ed6c18ef86d9235ce363a2bb6.png
Hi everyone!

Today's update brings a few really cool features. The first of all is the addition of melee attacks, which is a great addition to Badass Hero's move set. It allows him to pull off some really heroic actions, like shooting enemies in the face and finishing them off with katana, or slashing enemies mid-air. Altogether with dashing it makes the gameplay even more dynamic and spectacular than before!

The next cool feature is custom heads - now you will be able to put your own face or someone else's into the game! The instructions for adding them are at the end of this post. Also there's one built-in "Skullhead" custom head right now, but we'll be adding some more in next updates, and we'll integrate it with Steam Workshop so it'll be easy to share your creations with the Steam Community.

We've also finally found started working on the game's soundtrack and the old placeholder jungle music is now replaced with a proper one. In the future there will be three different jungle soundtracks and another three per each comic book. Also each soundtrack will dynamically change when you're doing a combo. We really hope that you will like it!

Another great improvement is that most weapons are now held with two both hands and have a reload animation. It makes Badass Hero look really badass, especially with the new assault rifle weapon time! Oh, and did we mention dual weapons?

We've also started to make the levels a bit more spacious. This will make it easier for you to avoid traps and enemies' projectiles!

If you like the game and how it's developing, please consider leaving a review. Thanks!

Here's instructions how to make your own head:

There are five .png files in "CustomHeads/Template" folder in the game installation folder. To make your own custom head you just need to create a new folder next to "Template" folder and put your .png files in it. They need to have heads placed on transparent background, like the examples in "Template" folder. You can use free software like Paint.Net (www.getpaint.net) or GIMP (www.gimp.org) to make those files.

The minimum requirement is to have "Head_Normal.png" file as it is default head displayed on your character. Optionally you can also add the following files:
- "Head_Hit.png" - displayed when the hero takes damage
- "Head_Shoot.png" - displayed when the hero shoots or attacks
- "Head_Light.png" - applied when the hero's gun fires bullets
- "Head_Blood.png" - applied when the hero's hit points is below 30%

The game scans the "CustomHeads" directory and loads its contents on launch, so you need to restart it if you modify the files after it started.

Support for uploading and downloading the custom heads to/from Steam Workshop will be added in one of the upcoming updates.

To make your own custom head you just need to create a new folder next to "Template" folder and put your .png files in it. They need to have heads placed on transparent background, like the examples in "Template" folder. You can use free software like Paint.Net (www.getpaint.net) or GIMP (www.gimp.org) to make those files.

The minimum requirement is to have "Head_Normal.png" file as it is default head displayed on your character. Optionally you can also add the following files:
- "Head_Hit.png" - displayed when the hero takes damage
- "Head_Shoot.png" - displayed when the hero shoots or attacks
- "Head_Light.png" - applied when the hero's gun fires bullets
- "Head_Blood.png" - applied when the hero's hit points is below 30%

The game scans the "CustomHeads" directory and loads its contents on launch, so you need to restart it if you modify the files after it started.

Support for uploading and downloading the custom heads to/from Steam Workshop will be added in one of the upcoming updates.
